absorbed into existing \\u003Cid\\u003E; retired as wrong or obsolete, with its reason; left alone; held out; not reached.\u0022,\u0022The template\\u0027s held-out rule keys on the In prompts line of h9k learn show, and says a lesson recorded on another node of the owner\\u0027s fleet that reaches prompts is an ordinary lesson.\u0022,\u0022The template allows retiring a lesson into an existing live lesson that already states its whole claim with no new lesson recorded, and allows retiring a lesson as wrong or obsolete only when its reason names evidence at the checkout\\u0027s commit (a file and line, or the absence of a named file or symbol).\u0022,\u0022The template states that every claim in a merged lesson appears in at least one lesson it cites, and that a merge longer than its sources together is not recorded because a new merge is the newest lesson and displaces recent ones from the prompt section.\u0022,\u0022The exit criterion no longer lets \\u0027no merge was warranted\\u0027 stand in for the per-lesson account.\u0022,\u0022The held-out sentence in LessonsDocumentRenderer.cs matches LessonProvenanceMark: fleet lessons that reach prompts are not described as held out, and the held-out kinds are named.\u0022,\u0022A test over h9k learn distill\\u0027s rendered draft asserts the six headings and the --limit 500 inventory command appear in it, and any golden or snapshot of the renderer\\u0027s output is updated.\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Content\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022The challenge of draft 9c5caf8c (report /Users/brianhallmanac/.hall9k/runs/01a1d1f9-680f-7475-b4ed-e35643a92bef/challenge-report.md) found defects that come from the shipped template .claude/templates/learn-distill/task.md, not from the draft: the earlier distillation 0fe36d3d had the same defects and was fixed by hand. The report\\u0027s section \\u0027Proposed criteria\\u0027 holds the exact replacement criteria and exit criterion; use them, with \\u003Cthis task\\u0027s id\\u003E filled by the template\\u0027s existing substitution. The same imprecise sentence about lessons from another node being held out appears in src/Hall9k.Domain/Features/Learning/LessonsDocumentRenderer.cs:64-68; LessonProvenanceMark.cs:63,146 lets lessons from the owner\\u0027s own fleet into prompts, and :82,93,97 hold out unknown-node, outside-fleet, and no-provenance lessons. inventory as the active list read at session start with \\u0060h9k learn list --project \\u003Cproject\\u003E --limit 500\\u0060 for a project scope, or \\u0060h9k learn list --owner --limit 500\\u0060 for the owner scope, and require the findings document\\u0027s \\u0022What was observed\\u0022 section to name every lesson in that inventory by id under exactly one of six headings: merged that per-lesson account even when no merge was warranted, and no longer offers \\u0022it says no merge was warranted\\u0022 as an alternative to it.\u0022,\u0022The authored text treats a lesson as held out (read-only, cited in no merge, named in the findings) exactly when \\u0060h9k learn show\\u0060 prints \\u0022In prompts no\\u0022 for it, and says that a lesson recorded on another node of the owner\\u0027s own fleet for which it prints \\u0022In prompts yes\\u0022 is an ordinary lesson for the task.\u0022,\u0022The authored criteria allow a lesson to be retired into an existing live lesson that already states its whole claim, with no new lesson recorded, and allow a lesson to be retired as wrong or obsolete only when its retirement reason names evidence at the checkout\\u0027s commit: a file and line, or the absence of a named file or symbol.\u0022,\u0022The authored criteria state that every claim in a merged lesson appears in at least one lesson it cites, and that a merge longer than its sources together is not recorded, because a recorded merge becomes the newest lesson and displaces recent ones from the injected prompt section.\u0022,\u0022Every \\u0060h9k learn\\u0060 record command shown in the authored criteria carries \\u0060--task\\u0060 with the authored task\\u0027s own id, as the command in the authored context already does.\u0022,\u0022The the held-out kinds: replicated from a node outside the owner\\u0027s fleet (or when the fleet cannot be read), recorded on a node nobody recorded, and recorded with no provenance. A test over \\u0060LessonsDocumentRenderer.Render\\u0060 asserts the fleet clause.\u0022,\u0022\\u0060docs/scope.md\\u0060 and \\u0060docs/cli.md\\u0060 no longer describe the citation as enforced for every merge: each says the decider refuses a distilled lesson whose citations resolve to nothing, repeat, or name the lesson itself, and that a plain \\u0060h9k learn\\u0060 with no \\u0060--distilled-from\\u0060 is recorded without any.\u0022,\u0022\\u0060LearningDistillTests\\u0060 asserts, over the task \\u0060LearningDistillCommand.Author\\u0060 produces for both a project scope and the owner scope, that the six headings and that scope\\u0027s \\u0060--limit 500\\u0060 inventory command appear in the criteria and the exit criterion, and that the authored text no longer contains \\u0022no way to record a merge without the citations\\u0022 or \\u0022or it says no merge was warranted\\u0022; its existing assertions on the old wording are updated to the new wording, and the class passes.\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022## Where the replacement text comes from\\n\\nThe challenge of the earlier distillation draft 9c5caf8c found these defects in the shipped template, not in that draft; the distillation before it (0fe36d3d) carried the same defects and was fixed by hand. The report is \\u0060/Users/brianhallmanac/.hall9k/runs/01a1d1f9-680f-7475-b4ed-e35643a92bef/challenge-report.md\\u0060. Its section \\u0022Proposed criteria, if a person republishes this once new lessons have accrued\\u0022 holds eight criteria and an exit criterion; use them as the replacement for the five \\u0060criterion-*\\u0060 keys and the \\u0060exit-criterion\\u0060 key in \\u0060.claude/templates/learn-distill/task.md\\u0060, with two substitutions: \\u0060\\u003Cthis task\\u0027s id\\u003E\\u0060 becomes \\u0060{{TaskId}}\\u0060, and \\u0060--project hall9k\\u0060 becomes \\u0060{{ListArguments}}\\u0060. The same report\\u0027s \\u0022False or misleading\\u0022 items 1 and 2 give the evidence for the citation and held-out corrections. The context key\\u0027s held-out paragraph and its \\u0022or the section says no merge was warranted\\u0022 clause need the same corrections as the criteria.\\n\\n## The code change the template needs\\n\\nToday only the \\u0060objective\\u0060 and \\u0060context\\u0060 keys receive substitutions. \\u0060LearningDistillCommand.Criteria()\\u0060 and \\u0060ExitCriterion()\\u0060 load their keys with no values (\\u0060src/Hall9k.Cli/Commands/LearningDistillCommand.cs:181,194-201\\u0060), so a \\u0060{{TaskId}}\\u0060 or \\u0060{{ListArguments}}\\u0060 placed in a criterion would reach the draft unreplaced. Both need the task id and the list arguments (built at \\u0060LearningDistillCommand.cs:217\\u0060) passed in from \\u0060Author\\u0060 (\\u0060:158-178\\u0060), and \\u0060Criteria()\\u0060 needs the new keys listed. The tests call \\u0060Criteria()\\u0060 directly (\\u0060tests/Hall9k.Tests/Cli/LearningDistillTests.cs:45,82,125\\u0060) and will need the new signature.\\n\\n## Facts the corrections rest on, at commit fa6b3970c\\n\\n- A call with no \\u0060--distilled-from\\u0060 goes to \\u0060LearningDecider.Record\\u0060, not \\u0060RecordDistilled\\u0060, so the empty-citation refusal never fires from the CLI (\\u0060src/Hall9k.Cli/Commands/LearnCommand.cs:123-127\\u0060; \\u0060src/Hall9k.Domain/Features/Learning/LearningDecider.cs:52-58,61-80\\u0060).\\n- \\u0060AgentOnFleetNode\\u0060 reaches prompts (\\u0060src/Hall9k.Domain/Features/Learning/LessonProvenanceMark.cs:63,146\\u0060). \\u0060AgentOnAnotherNode\\u0060 (outside the fleet or fleet unknown), \\u0060AgentOnUnobservedNode\\u0060, \\u0060ReplicatedFromOutsideFleet\\u0060 and \\u0060Unknown\\u0060 are held (\\u0060:73,82,93,97\\u0060), and \\u0060HeldFromPrompts\\u0060 (\\u0060:111-112\\u0060) lists them with their labels.\\n- \\u0060h9k learn show\\u0060 prints the \\u0022In prompts\\u0022 yes or no line (\\u0060src/Hall9k.Cli/Commands/LearningShowCommand.cs:144-150\\u0060).\\n- \\u0060h9k learn list\\u0060 shows 20 by default (\\u0060src/Hall9k.Cli/Commands/LearningListCommand.cs:23,69\\u0060).\\n- The injected section is newest first and ends at the first lesson that does not fit (\\u0060src/Hall9k.Domain/Features/Learning/InjectedLessons.cs:243-253\\u0060).\\n- The renderer\\u0027s held-out sentence is \\u0060src/Hall9k.Domain/Features/Learning/LessonsDocumentRenderer.cs:63-69\\u0060. \\u0060docs/concepts.md:115-121\\u0060 already describes the fleet rule correctly and can serve as wording.\\n- The doc sentences calling the citation enforced are \\u0060docs/scope.md:613-615\\u0060 and \\u0060docs/cli.md:195-199\\u0060.\\n- The assertions on the old wording are \\u0060LearningDistillTests.cs:50,52,55-58,179-180\\u0060. No prompt golden carries this template\\u0027s text.\\n\\n## Why the type is Bugfix and not Content\\n\\nThe template tells sessions false things about the platform, and the fix touches compiled code and tests. A Content task fails before its gates when its diff touches any path outside the project\\u0027s non-executable set, which here is \\u0060*.md\\u0060, \\u0060docs/\\u0060, \\u0060.claude/skills/\\u0060 and \\u0060assets/**\\u0060 (\\u0060src/Hall9k.Daemon/Execution/VerificationRunner.cs:319-333\\u0060). A template-only change would instead skip the gates entirely (\\u0060:293-303\\u0060) while the existing assertions above fail on main.\\n\\n## Out of scope\\n\\nLesson caps, the picker, and scoping a distillation to lessons recorded since the last one (a separate idea if wanted).
